title: Vituo vitatu bora vya kushukia Nagoya
label: Vituo 3 bora vya kushukia

text.In Nagoya, there are many stations where: Kuna vituo vingi Nagoya ambako treni za subway na JR husimama.
text.In the end, which station should you get: Basi, ni kituo gani unapaswa kushukia ili kufurahia Nagoya?
text.If someone asks me for the top 3, I will: Mtu akiniuliza vituo vitatu bora, nitajibu hivi.
text.If you want to enjoy just the inside of: Ukitaka kufurahia ndani ya kituo pekee, Kituo cha Nagoya ndicho cha kwanza.
text.It has everything, and I think it is fun: Kuna kila kitu hapo na ninaona panapendeza.
text.From Sakae Station, you can go to a plac: Kutoka Kituo cha Sakae unaweza kwenda mahali panapoitwa Oasis 21.
Pia kuna mnara maarufu wa televisheni.
text.There is quite a big level gap from 1st: Kuna tofauti kubwa ya ubora ikilinganishwa na nafasi ya kwanza na ya pili.
text.But if you ask for a station Nagoya can: Lakini ukiuliza kituo ambacho Nagoya inaweza kujivunia, ni Kituo cha Kanayama.
text.I think you use Kanayama Station when yo: Nadhani Kituo cha Kanayama hutumiwa unapoenda kwenye Uwanja wa Ndege wa Kimataifa wa Chubu Centrair na sehemu nyingine.
text.Honestly, if you go to Kanayama Station,: Kwa kweli, ukifika Kituo cha Kanayama unaweza kwenda popote.
text.At Kanayama Station, there is a place ca: Kwenye Kituo cha Kanayama kuna sehemu inayoitwa Asunal Kanayama.
text.If I have to name the top 3 stations to: Nikichagua vituo vitatu bora vya kushukia Nagoya, huu ndio mpangilio wangu.
